## 12. Standard close
- **What I saw:** The 7 net-new ads spent $127.90 of the $210 weekly cap (61%, under) and drove 12 unique inbound leads, but only 1 carries clean Google Ads attribution. Ad-level reporting is quota-blocked this cycle.
- **What it means:** With only 1 cleanly attributed lead, paid conversion quality is not yet measurable. CTR/CPC and cap compliance remain healthy at this volume; the ad-level gap is a data-completeness issue, not a performance signal.
- **Recommended next action:** Resolve the `search_term_view` tool gap so negative-keyword mining can run against ~70 accumulated clicks. **No approval required; no dollar amounts changed.**
spoken_text: Quick update: over the trailing 7 days our two new campaigns spent about $128 of the $210 weekly cap, so we're well under budget, and drove 12 unique leads plus 3 booked calls, but still only 1 lead has clean Google Ads tracking on it — that hasn't changed since this morning, and no new leads have come in since. The one thing worth doing next is fixing our search-term reporting tool so we can start trimming wasted clicks, but that's a tooling fix, not a budget change, so nothing needs your approval right now.
